svg.title: CERF C-Max HUD · fixed framebuffer at the upper left
svg.desc: A desktop layout proposal with the native 800 by 480 guest framebuffer anchored at the upper-left content origin, without stretching or automatic centering. A detailed C-Max-inspired Sony audio cluster and dual-knob climate panel occupy the space on the right, with a PRNDL lever and confirmed gear display below the framebuffer. All controls fit inside the illustrated desktop window. Smaller diagrams explain the fixed framebuffer bounds and window resizing.
svg.text: CERF / FORD SYNC 2 / C-MAX HUD STUDY 03
Anchor the screen. Keep the console.
The framebuffer keeps its native size at the upper left. Authentic controls use the remaining desktop space.
Tap a detent, or drag the lever.
A pending request is shown separately.
All illustrated controls fit in a 1792 × 936 window
The guest image has no centering transform.
On small windows, offer an explicit fit / compact view.
Metal trim and a real volume knob.
A lever with PRNDL detents and a boot.
One shared set of controls; a more faithful presentation.
C-Max inspired, rather than a dimensioned reproduction.
Upper-left framebuffer placement and detailed widgets are shown as a layout concept; the emulator UI is unchanged.
